jurisdiction.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Saint Kitts and Nevis has no AI-specific law, strategy or guidance. Its only AI-relevant instrument is the general Data Protection Act 2018, which governs the personal data used by AI systems but has been passed without a commencement order. A whole-of-government technology strategy was announced in September 2026 but has not been published.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Information, Communications and Technology
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from the Law Commission's official laws portal and the government information service. No searchable bills portal was found for the National Assembly, and the 2026 laws listing was empty. The announced technology strategy is tracked as a lead.

instruments.issuing_authority: National Assembly of Saint Christopher and Nevis
instruments.publisher_name: Law Commission of Saint Christopher and Nevis
instruments.current_status: Passed by the National Assembly on 4 May 2018, assented 23 May 2018 and published 7 June 2018 (Official Gazette No. 31 of 2018). Section 1(2) brings it into force on a day fixed by the Minister (of justice) by Order in the Gazette; no commencement order appears in the Law Commission's annual SRO listings for 2018-2025, so it is treated as enacted but not yet in force (as of 12 October 2026).
instruments.summary: Sets data protection principles (general, notice and choice, disclosure, security, retention, data integrity, access) for personal data processed by public and private bodies, including data processed by equipment operating automatically, and binds the State. It gives data subjects rights of access and rectification, restricts processing of sensitive personal data, and makes the Information Commissioner under the Freedom of Information Act the supervisory authority with complaint, investigation, information-notice, enforcement-notice and assessment powers, backed by offences and penalties. It contains no specific rule on automated decision-making or profiling.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The only national law governing the personal data used to train and run AI systems; not yet commenced.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National sources in Saint Kitts and Nevis were searched, including the Law Commission's annual laws, government news, ministries and regulators. Only the Data Protection Act 2018, for which no commencement order was found, was recorded; no qualifying material was found in any other category. Not yet verified from the official text: parliament's bills, for which no searchable portal was found, the 2026 gazette issues, and whether a commencement order or revised data protection bill exists.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. lawcommission.gov.kn: site search and annual-laws listings 2018-2025 (Acts, SROs) by file name; untitled 2025 files full-text scanned (several SRO scans not text-searchable). 2026 listing empty. No National Assembly bills portal. DPA 2018 has no automated-decision rule; recorded as general data protection law; adopted, no commencement order found. Copyright Act 2024 'computer-generated work' (no AI mention) - lead. Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Law Commission annual laws 2018-2025 (Acts and SROs) and site search: Data Protection Act 2018 recorded (not commenced); no AI law, AI provision, deepfake offence or AI bill found; Copyright Act 2024 computer-generated works to leads.; Government: SKNIS government news search and ICT/digital searches: no national AI strategy, policy or public-sector AI guideline published; Whole-of-Government Technology Strategy announced (lead).; Ministries: Education, Justice (VoiceIt deployment only), ICT searched; no ministry AI document found. Health, finance, labour, national security: searched, nothing found.; Regulators: Information Commissioner (data protection not commenced), FSRC, telecom (NTRC/ECTEL national notices): searched, nothing AI-specific found; no national cyber agency or standards AI adoption found.. Not reached: National Assembly bill pages (no searchable bills portal located); Official Gazette issues 2026 (Law Commission 2026 listing empty). Could not verify: Whether a 2026 commencement order or revised data protection bill exists (2026 annual-laws listing empty).. strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.
